dimension_evidence.diagnosis: Correct diagnosis must distinguish values used to execute a generated graph from metadata required to compile its symbolic trace. It must also explain why tensor metadata alone cannot identify symbolic tracing and why blindly extracting fake values from real tracing creates incompatible fake modes.
dimension_evidence.localization: The public Prompt gives only the false failure classification, symbolic-name symptom, and real-trace control. It exposes no source path, probe function, compiler entry point, graph metadata field, helper name, or change location; the solver must reproduce the validation path and trace argument provenance.
dimension_evidence.repair_regression: The repair must select compilation inputs from placeholder metadata only for symbolic traces and connect that selection to the failure probe without changing runtime execution inputs. The oracle covers one and multiple symbolic integer extents plus a real-traced control, so both undefined-symbol and fake-mode regressions are constrained.
